hints.title: Prioritize Negative Inversions
hints.text: To maximize the total sum, flipping negative numbers into positive values yields the largest possible increase. Start with the most negative numbers first.

hints.title: Exhaust Remaining Flips
hints.text: If all negative numbers have been converted to positive and remaining flip count is odd, flip the element with the smallest absolute value to minimize deduction.

hints.title: Sorting Procedure
hints.text: Sort the array. Iterate from left to right: if an element is negative and k > 0, negate it and decrement k. If k remains odd after the loop, negate the smallest value in the modified array.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of elements in array
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all combinations of k flips produces an exponential search space.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting the array enables greedy selection in O(N log N) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that even remaining flips cancel out and odd remaining flips must target the smallest absolute magnitude.
complexity.notes: Can also be solved in O(N) using counting sort or a min-heap.
